name: create_role
description: Create a role end-to-end: roles row + /knowledge/roles/<slug>/pitch.md + /knowledge/roles/<slug>/rubric.md, with the file paths linked back on the row. Auto-generates a unique slug from the title if not supplied. Idempotent on title — re-running with a colliding slug appends -2/-3/... so the operator UI's 'Add Role' button is safe to spam-click. Once this returns, downstream consumers (intake parser scoring, dossier enricher, candidate-view) see the role immediately.
